newsitem.title: USA: Wellman says resin markets still volatile.
newsitem.headline: Wellman says resin markets still volatile.

text.p: Wellman Inc said Monday that worldwide polyethylene terephthalate resin and polyester fiber markets remain volatile, after it reported lower first quarter earnings due to a substantial decrease in worldwide PET resins profitability.
The company reported earnings for the first quarter of $8.7 million, or $0.28 per share, compared to $11.7 million, or $0.35 per share, for the first quarter of 1996.
It said results improved from the fourth quarter, when it had earnings of $5.9 million, or $0.19 per share.
It said the improvement is indicative of some positive trends, but that PET resin and polyester fiber markets remain volatile.
"Global capacity oversupply continues to exert downward pressure on selling prices, while upward pressure on chemical raw material costs continues," the company said in a statement.
